import BusyBeaver.ZFC.EnumStackCount254

namespace CountAudit
open SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
open Code254 Enum254 EnumStackBarrier254 EnumStackCount254

#print axioms commands_code
#print axioms commands_nonempty
#print axioms positions_spec
#print axioms positions_nodup
#print axioms count_cons
#print axioms occurrences_spec
#print axioms occurrences_nodup
#print axioms total_succ
#print axioms image_injective
#print axioms image_earlier_drop
#print axioms all_pops_covered
#print axioms total_pops_le
#print axioms candidate_reserve
#print axioms credit_succ
#print axioms credit_zero
#print axioms credit_one
#print axioms cexec_safe
#print axioms exec_list_some
#print axioms candidate_some
#print axioms safe_boundaries
#print axioms run_none_add
#print axioms sound_from_credit
#print axioms credit_start_iff
#print axioms dirty_start_iff
#print axioms candidate_one_iff

-- The final endpoint accepts unrestricted formula, cache and stack numbers.
example (t stack h : Nat) :
    EnumSafeStart254.HaltsFrom ⟨0, 0, t, stack, 0, h⟩ ↔ C254 F :=
  dirty_start_iff t stack h

example (t stack h : Nat) :
    ¬ EnumSafeStart254.HaltsFrom ⟨0, 0, t, stack, 0, h⟩ ↔ ¬ C254 F :=
  not_congr (dirty_start_iff t stack h)

example (stack d : Nat) :
    EnumSafeStart254.HaltsFrom ⟨0, 1, 0, stack, d, 0⟩ ↔ C254 F :=
  candidate_one_iff 0 stack d 0 C254.truth C254.truth

example (k bottom : Nat) (s : St) (hpl : s.pl = 0) (hnp : s.np = k)
    (hs : PrefixInv bottom (credit k) (toW s)) :
    EnumSafeStart254.HaltsFrom s ↔ C254 F :=
  credit_start_iff k bottom s hpl hnp hs

example (k : Nat) : total isNip (k + 1) ≤ total isDrop k := all_pops_covered k
example (k : Nat) : count isNip (commands k) ≤ credit k := candidate_reserve k

example (hn : ¬ C254 F) (k bottom : Nat) (s : St)
    (hp : s.pl = 0) (hnp : s.np = k) (hs : PrefixInv bottom (credit k) (toW s)) (j : Nat) :
    ∃ t out, j ≤ t ∧ run t s = some out ∧ out.pl = 0 ∧ out.np = k + j ∧
      PrefixInv bottom (credit (k + j)) (toW out) :=
  safe_boundaries hn k bottom s hp hnp hs j

example (hn : ¬ C254 F) (cs : List Cmd) (bottom n : Nat) (w : W)
    (hs : PrefixInv bottom n w) (hc : count isNip cs ≤ n) :
    ∃ out, cexec cs w = some out ∧
      PrefixInv bottom (n + count isDrop cs - count isNip cs) out :=
  cexec_safe hn cs hs hc

example (cs : List Cmd) (c : Cmd) (s : St) (w : W)
    (hf : (fetch s).1 = encL c cs) (he : cexec (c :: cs) (toW s) = some w) :
    run (cs.length + 1) s = some ⟨0, (fetch s).2, w.tw, w.ws, w.d, w.h⟩ :=
  exec_list_some cs c s w hf he

example (k : Nat) (s : St) (w : W) (hp : s.pl = 0) (hn : s.np = k)
    (he : cexec (commands k) (toW s) = some w) :
    run (commands k).length s = some ⟨0, k + 1, w.tw, w.ws, w.d, w.h⟩ :=
  candidate_some k s w hp hn he

example (n m : Nat) (s : St) (h : run n s = none) : run (n + m) s = none :=
  run_none_add n m s h

example (m i : Nat) (h : i ∈ positions isNip (commands m)) :
    (image (m, i)).1 < m ∧
      (image (m, i)).2 ∈ positions isDrop (commands (image (m, i)).1) :=
  image_earlier_drop m i h

-- Exact small controls cover zero's reset code and the first marked pop.
example : commands 0 = [.mp 0] := by simp only [commands, decode_zero]
example : count isNip (commands 0) = 0 := by simp only [commands, decode_zero]; rfl
example : credit 1 = 0 := credit_one
example : context [] (encL (.drop 0) []) < context [] (encL (.nip 0) []) :=
  marked_drop_earlier [] [] 0

end CountAudit
